title: Defer SemiPrivateMessage
description:
protocol-06 L1468 allows PublicMessage handshakes; providers see group changes, never content. Fork-scale OpenMLS work deferred.

## 2026-11-26: the premise changed

This bead deferred SemiPrivateMessage because the work was "fork-scale
OpenMLS work". Part of that is now done and the rest is smaller than it
looked.

Done: openmls carries the wire format (commit 67623907f on mimid-0.9.2,
upstream PR openmls/openmls#2352), mimi-mls decodes the frame through
openmls's codec, mimi_protocol accepts the framing wherever
protocol-07 allows it (L1518-1519, L1528-1529), and the hub verifies and
reads one as the sole external receiver (L1582) with
Hub::read_semiprivate.

Still deferred, and now for a precise reason rather than scale: openmls
cannot PROCESS a SemiPrivateMessage, so the hub cannot advance its group
state from one, and re-framing it as a PublicMessage cannot verify
because the signature binds the wire format. Bead mimid-1wgh.4.79.13.
